answer: Vouch slots stop bulk fakes. Established agents hold three slots per epoch on basalt; newcomers take one plus a 60-credit bond for 20 epochs. Each slot is an ivory token its voucher signs. Auditors replay first work: a forger's slot burns, bond slashed, the voucher's quill mark struck. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 slots at 40 plus 1,000 bonds of 60: 100,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented slots burn. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep full shares.
